## HISTORY AND PHYSICAL
Date: 10/02/2026
## CC
Confusion, fever
## HPI
76 y/o F, unhoused (staying at a church parking lot shelter program), brought in by shelter staff for 2 days of new confusion, fever and urinary frequency. Shelter staff report she is usually "sharp" and manages her own pill box. In ED T 101.4F, disoriented to place and time, UA grossly positive.
## PMH

- Hyperlipidemia
- Osteoarthritis of knees
- No prior diagnosis of dementia

- Atorvastatin 20 mg daily

Never smoker. No alcohol or drugs. No family contact listed.

pages.title: History and Physical - page 2
pages.text:
## Exam
T 101.4F HR 104 BP 142/76 RR 18 SpO2 97% RA
Drowsy, oriented to person only, inattentive (CAM positive). Suprapubic tenderness. No focal neuro deficit.
## Data
WBC 14.1 H, Cr 1.3 (baseline unknown), Na 133, Glu 112
UA: + leukocyte esterase, + nitrite, >50 WBC
CT head: no acute abnormality, mild age-appropriate atrophy
## Assessment/Plan
1. Acute cystitis/pyelonephritis with sepsis physiology - ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily, urine culture pending, IV fluids
2. Acute metabolic encephalopathy (delirium) secondary to infection - delirium precautions, avoid sedatives, reorient
3. HTN - hold amlodipine while on fluids
4. Dispo - PT/OT when appropriate
Signed: Louise Moreau, MD 10/02/2026 15:40
